user.title: Sidebar Sites
user.description: This sets up Sidebar Sites. You add websites next, using the Configure button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sidebar Sites is already set up.

add_site.title: Add a site
add_site.description: The site shows as a page in the sidebar. For a site that blocks frames, or an HTTP site on an HTTPS Home Assistant, add it to the Sidebar Proxy add-on and use proxy://1 (site number 1, 2, and so on).

edit_site.title: Change a site
edit_site.description: Pick the site you want to change.

edit_site_form.title: Change a site
edit_site_form.description: The sidebar address stays the same, even if you change the name.

error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://, or be proxy://1 (for the Sidebar Proxy add-on).
error.duplicate_name: A site with this name already exists.
